annotations.title: Make papercraft, laser layers, bricks or a flexi toy

description: Turn one of the user's models into a craft to build by hand: papercraft (a PDF to print, cut and glue), laser (SVG layers for a laser cutter), bricks (building instructions and a parts list) or flexi (a print-in-place jointed toy; needs a rigged version from rig_model). Paid per new build — papercraft 10, laser 10, bricks 20, flexi 30 credits (a repeat or a failed build is not charged): tell the user the price and get their OK first. The files come as a ZIP. Takes 1–15 min; may return a task_id for get_task.

kind.description: papercraft, laser (laser-cut layers), bricks or flexi (print-in-place toy)

model_id.description: model_id of one of the user's models (list_models / get_task)

options.description: Optional settings of the chosen craft, e.g. {"size_cm": 25} — papercraft: detail simple|medium|detailed|expert, paper a4|letter, size_cm 8–45, color print|white; laser: height_cm 5–60, thickness 3|4|5|6, bed xtool_s1|glowforge|a4|a3|letter, kerf 0–0.4, holes none|3|5, guides true|false; bricks: size small|medium|large, palette full|basic, hollow true|false; flexi: length_cm 8–30, joints auto|few|many, clearance 0.25|0.35|0.45. Left out = the default.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result before answering with a task_id (0–50 s, default 30)
